editorialMarkers: A form-centric translation: it follows the word order and structure of the Hebrew and Greek closely, so the English shows how the original is built. Every word is aligned to the word it stands for in the unfoldingWord Hebrew Bible and Greek New Testament, which is where its Strong’s numbers, lemmas and morphology come from.
